Key.Original: We expected %1 to be almost empty of healthy life. Reports of sustained gunfire suggest an organized group is still out there. We do not know who they are or whether they will welcome us. Investigate the reported battle site.

Key.Original: Our forces entered %1 expecting few uninfected survivors. Now we have reports of armed people fighting the infected. Their identity and intentions are unknown. Search the battle site for evidence and find out who is living here.
